_readme: Retro learnings per launch, surfaced on the Launch Learnings tab so they
outlive the retro deck and stay attached to the launch's numbers.
HOW TO ADD ONE TODAY
Add an entry under the launch's id (matching config/launches.json) and
open a PR. It appears on the next refresh. Entries are versioned in git,
so who wrote what and when is recoverable.
WHY NOT AN IN-APP FORM YET
This dashboard is a static file server with no database and no write
path — the container serves committed files and holds no state. Letting
users type learnings straight into the page needs somewhere to put them
and an identity to attribute them to. Both already exist in the internal
portal (Postgres + Prisma + Google SSO + audit logging), so that is the
right home for an editable version; it is a portal change, not one that
belongs in this repo. Until then this file keeps the content durable and
visible, which is the part that matters most.
FIELDS
date     ISO date the learning was recorded (not the launch date).
author   Who recorded it. Shown verbatim.
category One of: merchandising, creative, pricing, inventory, traffic,
forecast, operations, other. Drives the tag colour.
title    One line. What was learned.
detail   Optional. The evidence or context behind it.
metric   Optional. A figure that supports it, quoted as text so it stays
true to what was known at the time rather than silently moving
with the data.
